description: Scores a payment system operator’s or overseer’s self-assessment against the 24 CPMI-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures (Apr 2012) or, for an authority role, the 5 responsibilities of central banks, market regulators and other relevant authorities, using the assessment methodology’s four-level rating scale plus not_applicable (Dec 2012, paras 3.18 and 3.21). Applies this tool’s own illustrative proportional tiers (systemic, prominent, small), explicitly NOT a CPMI-IOSCO classification, via a tier map carried as data beside the kernel with a source cite per cell; a not_applicable rating on a cell the map marks required is a violation. Produces a gap register sorted by severity then id, a date-ordered action plan for gaps carrying a target date, a summary by rating and a coverage percentage; an optional linked fast payment system governance module (CPMI Oct 2024 report, section 4) adds five linked-arrangement items. Scope limits: values-only, no PII, nothing external is read; all ratings are the caller’s declared values; the tool does not verify evidence and names no real system or authority. Prove deferred (section 18).
